identification: Single photo of a box of about 14 modern design, illustration and pop-culture books. Legible spines: Dinotopia (Gurney), The Animator's Survival Kit (Richard Williams), A Smile in the Mind (McAlhone and Stuart, Phaidon), Gravity Falls Journal 3, Women in Dior Portraits of Elegance, Scarygirl (Jurevicius), Live Aid The Concert, Graphic Artists Guild Handbook Pricing and Ethical Guidelines, Nature Notes of Edith Holden, Meggs A History of Graphic Design (Wiley), a leather-look archives Vol.1, Amazones (Le Goues, Studio Zero), Henry's Gift The Magic Eye. All are mass-market or trade reference titles with no early, signed or scarce Australiana; under the book rule none has a first edition worth hundreds. Animator's Survival Kit and Smile in the Mind are the strongest, typically tens of dollars each at best secondhand. Edition and printing cannot be told from the photo.
